texts.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

texts.zh:
一个公正的，由科学家和思想家组成的委员会正聚集在我们的联邦内庭。他们想要在我们即将开始的领导力测验中为[root.GetAllianceName]提供学术仲裁。

每个帝国现在可以聚集一支团队来研究这一问题，这一研究的结果将会对我们的联邦产生积极影响。这只团队将会发表他们的结果在公开的讨论区。无论哪篇论文在创新、科学严谨性和连贯性方面得分最高，它的作者帝国都将在下一期获得领导地位。

不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。
texts.en:
An impartial committee of scientists and thinkers is gathering within our federation chambers. Its purpose: to serve the [root.GetAllianceName] as academic arbiters during our upcoming leadership contest.

Each empire will now assemble a team of researchers to investigate an issue, the findings of which should somehow benefit the future of our federation. The teams will present their findings to an open forum. Whichever thesis study rates highest in innovation, scientific rigor and coherence will earn its authors' empire the right of leadership for the next term.

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

tooltips.en: The thesis challenge will commence shortly.

texts.zh: 在我们缺席该项竞赛的同时，联邦委员会选择了获胜的议题。[winning_thesis.GetName]由于它们关于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的研究被授予了在下一届的领导权。这次竞赛水平低下，要是我们研究团队参赛的话很可能能走上领奖台。
texts.en: The Federation Committee chose its winning argument whilst we remained absent from the contest. The [winning_thesis.GetName] has been granted leadership following their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. A low bar has been set for the time when a research team of our own might take to the podium.

texts.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了我们对于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]研究的内在价值，授予[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]在下一届的领导权。人们向[ruler.GetTitle]和[ruler.GetHerHis]的研究团队致以贺词。
texts.en: The Federation Committee has recognized the inherent value of our study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic], granting [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term. Congratulatory sentiments have been offered to our [ruler.GetTitle] and [ruler.GetHerHis] team of researchers.

texts.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了由我们[ruler.GetTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]领导的研究及其对于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的可靠论证。[ruler.GetSheHeCap]在下一任中的领导应该会相当成功。
texts.en: The Federation Committee has recognized our infallible reasoning in a study conducted by [ruler.GetTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. [ruler.GetSheHeCap] shall assume a most prosperous leadership for the next term.

texts.zh: 联邦委员会已经认可了我们对[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]整合研究的价值。他们已经授予了我们在[root.GetAllianceName]的下一届领导权。
texts.en: The Federation Committee has recognized the worthiness of our amalgamated study into [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. They have granted leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName] to us for the next term.

texts.zh: 联邦委员会略过了我们提交的论文，对来自[winning_thesis.GetName]的关于[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的空洞研究加以青睐。科学本身应该为这种理性的丧失哀悼。同时，[winning_thesis.GetName]确保了在[root.GetAllianceName]的领导权。
texts.en: The Federation Committee has passed over our proposal, favoring a vacuous study from the [winning_thesis.GetName] on [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]. Science itself shall mourn this loss of reason. In the meantime, the [winning_thesis.GetName] assumes leadership of the [root.GetAllianceName].

texts.zh: 联邦委员会犯下种种错误，轻率地选择了[winning_thesis.GetName]的论文而不是我们的。[winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic]的研究莫名其妙地赢得了[winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle][winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName]在下一届的领导权。
texts.en: In a wanton act of motley failure, the Federation Committee has selected a thesis by the [winning_thesis.GetName] rather than our own. Their study of [winning_thesis.GetThesisTopic] has inexplicably granted [winning_thesis.ruler.GetTitle] [winning_thesis.ruler.GetRegnalName] leadership for the next term.

tooltips.en: We shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during its next term.

tooltips.zh: 我们无法保持在[Root.GetAllianceName]的领导地位。[winning_thesis.GetName]将会取代我们。
tooltips.en: We have failed to secure leadership of [Root.GetAllianceName]. The [winning_thesis.GetName] will take that role instead.

summary.text:
# 联邦委员会已成立 / A Federation Committee is Formed
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 联邦领袖挑战 federation leadership challenge

## 如何开始 How it starts

联邦领袖换届时（on_federation_leader_challenge，`00_on_actions.txt:3560–3568`）同时触发五个隐藏根事件（fedel.1、500、900、1500、1800），每个只在联邦的“挑战类型”法律与之匹配时通过（`13_challenge_type.txt`）。隐藏根 fedel.1500 要求联邦采用“委员会论文”类挑战（thesis_underway 标志）；向成员发 **1501**，之后 60 天由委员会选出论文。 / When a federation leadership challenge starts (on_federation_leader_challenge, 00_on_actions.txt:3560–3568) five hidden roots (fedel.1, 500, 900, 1500, 1800) fire; each passes only if the federation’s challenge-type law matches (13_challenge_type.txt). Hidden fedel.1500 starts the committee-thesis challenge (thesis_underway flag) and sends 1501 to members; 60 days later the committee chooses a thesis.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **联邦委员会成立（1501）**：一个公正的科学家与思想家委员会开始工作，成员可提交各自的论点（“为了科学！”）。/ An impartial committee forms; members may submit arguments.
2. **论文被选中（1506）**（60 天后）：胜出的论点所属成员成为联邦领袖；有胜者和落选者两种选项文本（“好极了”/“该死”）。/ After 60 days a winning thesis is chosen; its owner leads the federation.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

胜出者与落选者看到不同选项。/ Winners and losers see different options.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

成员提交的论点取决于其科研方向。/ Submitted arguments depend on research.

- 已核对 Checked：根 1500、1501、1506。/ Root and events.
- 审阅改动 Changes：结构与草稿一致。/ Matches the draft.
- 不确定 Uncertain：论文胜出的具体计分规则未展开。 / The thesis scoring rule was not expanded.
